name: Copulation
overview: Scripture clearly defines boundaries for copulation, emphasizing holiness and separation as commanded by the LORD. Sexual relations are forbidden between close relatives to preserve purity within the family (Leviticus 18:6). Additionally, sexual activity is prohibited during a woman's menstrual period, as she is considered ceremonially unclean and must be set apart (Leviticus 15:19; 18:19). These instructions underscore God's design for sexual conduct, calling His people to honor His holiness in intimate relationships.
